summary: PREPARE: loaded STD-GOV, STD-RCA, STD-SAFETY, the safety-critical-change SKILL.md and DEMO_NOTES.md. EXECUTE: the brief's required input is missing. There is no drill-14 savecase, and backend/tests/data does not exist on any branch. The function plan_restoration also does not exist; the entry point is build_plan via POST /flisr/plan. Without that input I cannot say the reproduction is drill 14 unless I assume it, so the verdict is BLOCKED. On the shipped FDR-1201 model, a fault on the tail section SEC-1201-04 does reproduce the DEF-FLISR-7 behaviour: build_plan returns 'close TIE-1201-1405' and re-energises the faulted section. That failing test is committed at a6c2139 on agent/rca-backfeed/explore. A seeded sweep (600 feeders) gives a back-feed in 168/168 tie-adjacent faults, 0/279 non-adjacent faults, and correct location in 447/447 cases. Runtime counterfactuals show that removing the tie skip at :42 alone does not fix it; it must be combined with excluding isolation-point ties from restoration. No production code was changed. VERIFY: checked against STD-RCA-1, STD-SAFETY-3/7/8 and STD-GOV-1/2/7. pytest: 1 new test fails as intended, 2 existing tests pass. ruff check backend passes; tools/ has an existing UP017 failure on main. DELIVER: a candidate hypothesis and evidence package are attached. Confirming them against drill 14 needs answers to Q-EXPLORE-1 and Q-EXPLORE-2.
